violation_type.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -6 hours in specific topics (26 TAC §747.1309(b))
violation_type.short_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -6 hours in specific topics
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver is lacking 3 hours of required training in this section and needs to provide 3 hours of training in child development, age-appropriate curriculum, guidance and discipline, and or teacher-child interaction.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregiver is lacking 3 hours of required training in this section and needs to provide 3 hours of training in child development, age-appropriate curriculum, guidance and discipline, and or teacher-child interaction.

The primary caregiver needs to receive 6 clock hours of annual training in one or more the following topics for the September 2020-Septembber 2021 training year.  1. Child development and growth  2. Guidance and discipline  3. Age appropriate activities  4. Teacher child interaction  5. Caring for children with special needs    These 6 clock hours will be counted as make-up training hours and will not be counted towards the current training year.
Primary caregiver was lacking the required annual training.

The primary caregiver needs 6 clock hours under topics. Child growth and development Guidance and discipline Age-appropriate curriculum Teacher-child interaction.     The primary caregiver's 6 clock hours of make-up training will not count towards the current training year 03/22/2023-03/22/2024.
The primary caregiver was lacking training in the required topics.
The primary caregiver has completed 2 clock hours of training in this section and needs to complete 3 more clock hours of annual training in this area.
